metrics.window_convention: WP-10w uses the next-most-recent contiguous equivalent-length evaluation window before REP-0012 / OL-0012: 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. No separate IS metric convention is introduced; in_sample.sharpe records the same actual window Sharpe for schema continuity.

data_provenance.source_data_notes: OL-0013 derives from REP-0013. REP-0013 used the next-most-recent contiguous equivalent-length evaluation window before REP-0012 / OL-0012, covering 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11. This window is distinct from and not cloned from the prior REP-0012 / OL-0012 window.

notes: WP-10x derives OL-0013 from REP-0013 for H-004 / research_oos / post_wp_5b / d2_006_gates. The gross_pnl > 0 value and cost_drag_fraction are preserved from REP-0013. WP-10x performs no D2 cost-drag pass/fail reconciliation; any cost-drag comparison handling belongs to the later WP-10y REC package if Main 3.0 authorizes it. No REC-5 satisfaction is claimed, and this OL carries no policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper/live, runtime, promotion, demotion, or protected-path authority.
